name: Session Disconnected Status
description: Keeps a window's last Workbench view after its Session connection ends and offers an explicit reconnect.

states: Inspect the persistent Disconnected label and the Reconnect action with its explanation in English and Simplified Chinese.

useWhen: A Server Client window's connection to its Session ended while its last Workbench view remains.
avoidWhen: The window never reached its Session; the Session Unavailable surface explains that instead.
One terminal's projection failed while the Session connection remains; the terminal surface owns that recovery.
invariants: Nothing reconnects automatically; only the person's Reconnect starts a new connection.
The last Workbench view stays visible and is never replaced by the status.
The status stays clear of the bottom-end region that Workbench notices and terminal control status use.
All user-facing copy is provided by the Orchbee localization catalog.
